ctx.x: [Alborn's] Horseshoe. A bandstand behind the bar, you know, at the end of the bar. It wasn't a circular bar. And a nice little bandstand, good acoustics, a nice band. I sure hated to see it go the way it did. Well, in the meanwhile, Buddy de Franco and Louis had received wires to rejoin Tommy Dorsey in Miami, Florida. For rehearsals. But they didn't send for Charlie because they didn't want Charlie in the South, and he was supposed to rejoin the band someplace else. So while we're in Chicago, Hank and Buddy…

My feathers fell. I said, "Well, at this point, I wouldn't advise you to call me anything." Because if this had been in New York, I know what I would have done. I would have thrown a punch across the bar, and that's what they were hoping that I would do, you know antagonize me into doing something wrong, where they could shoot me down. Because I understand one of these policemen had killed a serviceman for urinating in the alley because he wasn't ten feet off the streets. The soldier wasn't too bad, because I…

know. But I didn't want to have any parts of the club, not any. Do you blame me? So I got in touch with Charlie. I said, 'Well, I just called Big Sid long distance to send me some money. I'm leaving.' He said, 'Well, man, you didn't have to do that.' He says, 'Tomorrow night's pay night.' And he gave us this night off, you know, ahead of pay night. He says, 'So wait for the banks to open and I'll pay your salary, you know, your week's salary.' So we go to the bank. Ike and I stand outside. By this time he has a…
